stories.summary_de: ARTnews stellt acht einflussreiche Galerien in Indien mit innovativen Programmen vor. Die Auswahl zeigt führende Galerien des Landes.

stories.headline_en: Cool Britannia energy returns to London market
stories.headline_de: Cool Britannia Energie kehrt zum Londoner Markt zurück
stories.summary_en: A fascination with Cool Britannia is evident at exhibitions, auctions and art fairs in London. Some question whether a revival of this era is possible or wise.

stories.summary_de: The Influencer Project, ein Horrorfilm über die Gefahren sozialer Medien, wurde veröffentlicht. Britische Social-Media-Star Chiara King spielt sich selbst in dem in Kopenhagen angesiedelten Film über Stalking und Online-

stories.headline_de: 39 Bilder verändern Wahrnehmung von Männlichkeit in der Kunst

stories.headline_en: Art Basel Paris 2026: fifth anniversary edition
stories.headline_de: Art Basel Paris 2026: Fünfjähriges Jubiläum
stories.summary_en: Art Basel Paris celebrates its fifth birthday with exhibitions and events around the Grand Palais.
stories.summary_de: Art Basel Paris feiert sein fünfjähriges Jubiläum mit Ausstellungen und Events rund um den Grand Palais.

stories.headline_en: Stadttempel synagogue restored after Nazi era
stories.headline_de: Stadttempel-Synagoge nach Nazi-Zeit restauriert
stories.summary_en: The 200-year-old Stadttempel, Vienna's only synagogue to survive the 1938 Nazi annexation, has undergone restoration. The heritage-protected building has been pieced together by a restoration team.
stories.summary_de: Die 200 Jahre alte Stadttempel, Wiens einzige Synagoge, die die Nazi-Annexion 1938 überstand, wurde restauriert. Das unter Denkmalschutz stehende Gebäude wurde von einem Restaurierungsteam wieder zusammengesetzt.

stories.headline_en: Norton Simon Museum Countersues Over Cranach
stories.headline_de: Norton Simon Museum verklagt zurück wegen Cranach
stories.summary_en: Norton Simon Museum has filed a countersuit against the Jewish Federation regarding a Cranach diptych. The Met has also named Danh Võ for a Genesis Façade Commission.
stories.summary_de: Das Norton Simon Museum hat Gegenklage gegen die Jewish Federation eingereicht bezüglich eines Cranach-Diptychons. Das Met hat Danh Võ für eine Genesis Façade Commission benannt.

stories.headline_en: Goldsmiths strike longest in UK university history
stories.headline_de: Goldsmiths-Streik längster in der UK-Universitätsgeschichte
stories.summary_en: A staff strike at Goldsmiths has reached 130 days, making it the longest in UK university history. Students report not receiving marks or feedback as the dispute over the institution's restructuring programme continues.
stories.summary_de: Ein Streik der Goldsmiths-Mitarbeiter dauert nun 130 Tage an und ist damit der längste in der Geschichte britischer Universitäten. Studierende berichten, dass sie keine Noten oder Rückmeldungen erhalten, während der Stre

stories.headline_de: Neuer Kulturbereich Noma für Abu Dhabi angekündigt
stories.summary_en: Abu Dhabi will launch a new cultural district called Noma, positioned near the Saadiyat Cultural District where Frieze Abu Dhabi will debut next month. The inaugural Frieze fair marks a major art event for the emirate.

stories.headline_de: Fair Play startet mit guten Besucherzahlen aber langsamen Verkäufen
stories.summary_en: Fair Play, an artist-first fair that charges commission rather than stand fees, launched during London Frieze week with strong attendance. However, sales remained slow during the event.
stories.summary_de: Fair Play, eine künstlerorientierte Messe, die auf Provisionen statt Standgebühren setzt, startete während der Londoner Frieze-Woche mit guten Besucherzahlen. Allerdings blieben die Verkäufe während des Events gering.

stories.headline_de: Sanaz Sohrabi erforscht OPEC in Feature-Dokumentarfilm

stories.headline_en: Rubaiya Qatar Quadrennial Announces 120+ Artists
stories.headline_de: Rubaiya Qatar Quadrennial kündet 120+ Künstler an
stories.summary_en: The inaugural Rubaiya Qatar Quadrennial has named more than 120 artists. The lead exhibition, "Unruly Waters," will feature two additional exhibitions and a public art program.

stories.headline_en: Frieze London: dinner dance, Barbie and Warhol highlights
stories.headline_de: Frieze London: Tanzessen, Barbie und Warhol Highlights

stories.headline_en: Cannupa Hanska Luger's Visual History
stories.headline_de: Cannupa Hanska Lugers Bildgeschichte
stories.summary_en: Cannupa Hanska Luger's work combines formal beauty with embedded visual history of destruction. The Native artist's forms seduce while carrying deeper historical meaning.
stories.summary_de: Cannupa Hanska Lugers Werk verbindet formale Schönheit mit eingebetteter Bildgeschichte der Zerstörung. Die Formen des Native-amerikanischen Künstlers verführen und tragen tiefere historische Bedeutung.

stories.headline_de: Artavazd Pelechians Distanz-Montage

stories.headline_en: Tanya Merrill's New Work and Life Changes
stories.headline_de: Tanya Merrills neue Werke und Lebenswechsel
stories.summary_en: After relocating upstate and welcoming a newborn, artist Tanya Merrill's recent work reflects her immediate surroundings and life circumstances.
stories.summary_de: Nach einem Umzug in den Norden und der Geburt eines Kindes spiegelt Tanya Merrills neue Arbeit ihre unmittelbare Umgebung wider.

stories.headline_de: Gallium-Statue der Klimagruppe schmilzt in der Hitze
stories.summary_en: A gallium statue installed outdoors in Tallahassee on October 13 by climate group 350 Action began melting shortly after installation. The artwork appears to respond literally to rising temperatures.

stories.headline_en: George Osborne Aided British Museum Sponsorship Deal
stories.headline_de: George Osborne unterstützte British-Museum-Sponsoring
stories.summary_en: Emails show George Osborne personally helped secure a controversial $6.6 million British Museum sponsorship, approving negotiations within 90 minutes of receiving a donor assessment.
stories.summary_de: E-Mails zeigen, dass George Osborne persönlich ein umstrittenes $6,6-Millionen-Sponsoring des British Museum sicherte und Verhandlungen innerhalb von 90 Minuten nach Erhalt einer Spendenderbewertung genehmigt.

stories.headline_en: Contemporary art centre Large opens near Paris
stories.headline_de: Kunstzentrum Large eröffnet bei Paris
stories.summary_en: Non-profit Large opens on an island near Paris with a show exploring the island's automotive history. The centre is focused on promoting the French art scene.

stories.headline_en: Centre Pompidou Brazil Branch Delayed to 2029

stories.summary_en: Construction on the planned Centre Pompidou Paraná has not yet begun and is now scheduled for 2029. The Brazilian outpost remains in development.
stories.summary_de: Der Bau des geplanten Centre Pompidou Paraná hat noch nicht begonnen und ist nun für 2029 geplant. Der brasilianische Ableger ist noch in Entwicklung.

stories.headline_en: Miami Dealer Sentenced for Selling Fake Warhols
stories.headline_de: Miamis Kunsthändler wegen Fälschungsverkauf verurteilt
stories.summary_en: A Miami art dealer was sentenced to nearly four years in prison for selling forged works. A family reported spending $6 million on the forgeries.

stories.headline_en: "9 Temples to Heaven" explores faith
stories.headline_de: "9 Temples to Heaven" erforscht den Glauben
stories.summary_en: Director Sompot Chidgasornpongse uses patient observation to follow a single family on a quest to find a miracle. The work examines faith and its contradictions.
stories.summary_de: Regisseur Sompot Chidgasornpongse nutzt geduldige Beobachtung, um eine Familie auf ihrer Suche nach einem Wunder zu begleiten. Das Werk untersucht Glauben und seine Widersprüche.

stories.headline_en: Art World Guide to Paris During Art Basel
stories.headline_de: Kunstwelt-Guide zu Paris während Art Basel
stories.summary_en: A guide to dining, accommodations, and shopping venues in Paris during Art Basel, featuring Basque cuisine, pizza, and antiques markets.

stories.headline_en: Frieze London Focus section showcases young galleries
stories.headline_de: Frieze London Focus zeigt junge Galerien

stories.headline_en: Week in pictures: global photojournalism

stories.headline_en: Police Recover Stolen Religious Artworks From Spanish Churches
stories.headline_de: Polizei stellt gestohlene Kunstwerke aus spanischen Kirchen sicher
stories.summary_en: Spanish police recovered three religious artworks stolen from churches. One angel sculpture remains missing despite an arrest in September.
stories.summary_de: Spanische Polizei stellte drei aus Kirchen gestohlene religiöse Kunstwerke sicher. Eine Engelskulptur bleibt trotz einer Verhaftung im September vermisst.

stories.headline_en: Robin Hunter-Blake: Severe Mercy
stories.headline_de: Robin Hunter-Blake: Severe Mercy
stories.summary_en: 'Robin Hunter-Blake: Severe Mercy' at Isamaya Ffrench's London concept store offers a richly immersive experience. The exhibition presents works described as emotional and visceral.

stories.headline_en: Design at Frieze London
stories.headline_de: Design auf der Frieze London
stories.summary_en: Design highlights furniture at Frieze London, featuring works from designers including Martino Gamper and Rio Kobayashi. Chairs and cabinets showcase design focus at the art fair.

stories.headline_de: 10 Herbstausstellungen in Paris

stories.headline_de: Tate Modern erforscht Pictorialism und Soft-Focus

stories.summary_en: Lucien Smith's final paintings are going on view, while Sarah Michelson's work is presented as a MoMA finale. David Rimanelli is noted as 'apprehensive' about Alex Da Corte.

stories.headline_de: Renoirs Tanz im Moulin de la Galette in London

stories.headline_en: Esperanza Spalding honors Wayne Shorter in Vienna

stories.summary_en: Esperanza Spalding performed at Vienna's Konzerthaus, highlighting the orchestral works of legendary saxophonist Wayne Shorter. The evening was described as magical.

stories.headline_en: The bangs comeback: fashion meets ideology

stories.summary_en: The fringe hairstyle appears to be experiencing a resurgence, including in political circles. The article explores whether this aesthetic carries political or ideological meaning.

stories.summary_en: Yond Interiors has softened the raw wood shell of a historic New Hampshire structure. The conversion creates an idyllic setting for enjoying New England autumns.
